messages:
maria gonzalez: heads-up — starting runtime interop sweep for cypress-9B. suspect RoPE/rotary mismatch after q4 quant. filing intake here so we can prioritize.

maria gonzalez: artifacts: s3://rdw-models/cypress-9b/release/v1/ (weights + tokenizer + config). model uses rotary embeddings per upstream.

dan huang: copying. can you drop the eval set that showed regressions? which quant recipe did you try?

maria gonzalez: eval set: s3://rdw-evals/llm-regression/cypress-smoke/short_promptset.jsonl. quant recipe: q4_0 from local quant runner (branch: feat/quant-q4). observed perplexity drift ~2.1x on some prompts.

vikram patel: quick smoke command you can run locally:
```bash
./runtime-smoke --model s3://rdw-models/cypress-9b/release/v1/ --quant q4_0 --kv-test --max-tokens 512
```
I ran this against runtime-prod-3 and saw KV mismatch warnings in the logs (KV length and position embedding mismatch).

maria gonzalez: paste of the important log lines:
```
[2025-06-21T14:03:12Z] warn: kv_cache_mismatch: expected seq 1024 got 1008 at layer 10
[2025-06-21T14:03:12Z] debug: rope_phase_diff: 0.00037 -> outputs diverge after token 28
```

sasha lee: two hypotheses: 1) quant packing changed the scale used in rotary trig tables, 2) runtime kernel assumes legacy rotary (sin/cos ordering) while model uses packed RoPE. run a small deterministic check: feed a 40-token prompt and compare logits (float32 unquantized) vs q4 inference.

maria gonzalez: ok running that now, will push results to the thread.

infra-bot: CI job queued: model-interop-smoke/cypress-9b (#review-391).

ci-bot: model-interop-smoke/cypress-9b: job failed — kv-smoke step failed on runtime-prod-3 (exit 2). logs uploaded to: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/391/logs

dan huang: for mitigation plan, we should add a canary route that falls back to rope-compat variant. sample rollout snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: cypress-9b-canary
    match: header(x-canary) == 'rope-compat'
    model: cypress-9b-v1-rope-compat
    rollout: 5%
```
Add that to the dedicated/manifest for emergency fallback.

vikram patel: also add a unit test to runtime-smoke: compare first 64 logits between float32 and quant path; threshold 1e-3 for non-eos tokens. if failed -> block rollout.

maria gonzalez: results from deterministic check: float32 vs q4_0 logits diff > 1e-2 starting at token 29. attaching small diff file to CI artifact.

sasha lee: thanks — this is high priority. marking P0 for onboarding until we confirm kernel parity.

maria gonzalez: next steps: (1) run kernel parity with `--rope-style=legacy|packed` on prod nodes, (2) try q4_k_maybe quant recipe, (3) create canary route and block rollout until smoke passes. will update timeline by EOD. :white_check_mark:
